title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi missiles headed for Riyadh
paragraphs: The Saudi-led coalition supporting Yemen’s internationally recognised government said it has intercepted three ballistic missiles fired by Yemen’s Houthi rebels towards Riyadh, after a flurry of emergency alerts in the Saudi capital.

The attack early on Saturday morning came two days after a Houthi strike damaged the Public Investment Fund tower, the headquarters of Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund and Riyadh’s tallest skyscraper.
It was the third day in a row that Saudi Arabia issued and quickly lifted alerts for Riyadh.
